scope: P3 bounded automatic Repair recovery coordination
claims: resolved incidents with blocked members use an explicit indexed recovery queue rather than scanning historical incidents
the existing Recruiting reconcile timer opens at most one incident batch and at most 100 Works per tick
successful batches rotate a large incident behind older pending incidents and the final batch atomically clears recovery_pending
recruiting.system.status exposes the indexed automatic recovery queue length in its consistent operational snapshot
automatic batches retain deterministic command receipts, incident version fencing, one aggregate event, and at most one wake per capability
manual and automatic recovery share the same Repository CAS transaction, making a concurrent loser a harmless conflict
